title: CLI verb alias sweep for observed wrong guesses
description:
Session mining captured live wrong-guess invocations that each cost a failed command plus retry: `dep remove` (3 sessions), `issue complete`, `issue edit`, a three-step guess chain for adding a label to an issue, and cross-group removal-verb guesses (issue delete vs dep rm vs gate remove vs doc remove).

## Background

Decided policy: hints only — no new aliases, no sugar commands. Existing per-group spellings remain canonical and are not renamed; every observed wrong guess fails fast with an actionable message naming the canonical command.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-01: Wrong removal-verb spellings in the issue, dep, gate, and doc groups (the rm/remove/delete variants that do not exist in that group) fail with a hint naming that group's canonical command.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-02: `issue complete` and `issue edit` fail with hints naming the update command and, for complete, its state flag.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-03: Adding a label to an issue via the label command fails with a hint redirecting to the update command's label flag, and the label command's help disambiguates namespace management from issue labeling.
